import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "font.size": 11, "text.color": "#263238", "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "svg.fonttype": "path", })
BLUE = "#33658A" TEAL = "#2A9D8F" SLATE = "#657786" INK = "#263238"
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(10, 4), dpi=100) ax = fig.add_axes([0, 0, 1, 1]) ax.set_xlim(0, 1) ax.set_ylim(0, 1) ax.axis("off")
ax.text( 0.04, 0.915, "Deriving the orthogonal projection coefficient", fontsize=20, weight="semibold", ha="left", va="center", color=INK ) ax.text( 0.04, 0.825, r"Assume nonzero, mutually orthogonal vectors " r"$u_0,\ldots,u_{N-1}$ and $x\in\mathrm{span}\{u_0,\ldots,u_{N-1}\}$.", fontsize=10.5, color=SLATE, ha="left", va="center" )
for x, number, title in [ (0.04, "01", "Expand the vector"), (0.355, "02", "Take the inner product"), (0.755, "03", "Isolate the coefficient"), ]: ax.text(x, 0.725, number, fontsize=10, color=SLATE, va="center") ax.text(x + 0.032, 0.725, title, fontsize=11.2, color=BLUE, weight="semibold", va="center")
for x0, x1 in [(0.307, 0.339), (0.705, 0.738)]: ax.annotate( "", xy=(x1, 0.565), xytext=(x0, 0.565), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color=SLATE, lw=1.2, mutation_scale=11) )
# The vector identity is wrapped without altering any terms. ax.text( 0.166, 0.575, r"$c_0u_0+\cdots+c_ku_k$", fontsize=15, ha="center", va="center", color=INK ) ax.text( 0.166, 0.475, r"$+\cdots+c_{N-1}u_{N-1}=x$", fontsize=15, ha="center", va="center", color=INK ) ax.text( 0.166, 0.315, "An orthogonal expansion of x", fontsize=10, color=SLATE, ha="center", va="center" )
ax.text( 0.525, 0.645, r"Apply $\langle u_k,\,\cdot\,\rangle$ to both sides", fontsize=10, color=SLATE, ha="center", va="center" )
# Assemble each line from measured mathtext segments so cancellation # strokes affect only the off-diagonal terms. fig.canvas.draw() renderer = fig.canvas.get_renderer()
def equation_row(parts, y, center=0.525, fontsize=13): artists = [] widths = [] for text, color, cancel in parts: artist = ax.text( 0, y, text, fontsize=fontsize, color=color, ha="left", va="center", alpha=0.64 if cancel else 1 ) width = artist.get_window_extent(renderer=renderer).width / fig.bbox.width artists.append((artist, cancel)) widths.append(width) x = center - sum(widths) / 2 for (artist, cancel), width in zip(artists, widths): artist.set_x(x) if cancel: ax.plot( [x + 0.003, x + width - 0.003], [y - 0.010, y + 0.010], color=SLATE, lw=1.1, alpha=0.8, solid_capstyle="round" ) x += width
equation_row([ (r"$\langle u_k,c_0u_0\rangle$", SLATE, True), (r"$+\cdots$", INK, False), ], 0.555)
equation_row([ (r"$+\,c_k\langle u_k,u_k\rangle$", TEAL, False), (r"$+\cdots$", INK, False), ], 0.465)
equation_row([ (r"$+\,\langle u_k,c_{N-1}u_{N-1}\rangle$", SLATE, True), (r"$=\langle u_k,x\rangle$", INK, False), ], 0.375, fontsize=12.5)
ax.text( 0.525, 0.278, r"orthogonality: vanishes for $j\ne k$", fontsize=10, color=SLATE, ha="center", va="center" ) ax.text( 0.525, 0.220, r"$\langle u_k,u_j\rangle=0\quad(j\ne k)$", fontsize=11, color=SLATE, ha="center", va="center" ) ax.text( 0.525, 0.125, r"$c_k\langle u_k,u_k\rangle=\langle u_k,x\rangle$", fontsize=14, color=TEAL, ha="center", va="center" ) ax.text( 0.525, 0.064, "Only the k-th term survives.", fontsize=10, color=TEAL, ha="center", va="center" )
ax.text( 0.862, 0.535, r"$c_k=\dfrac{\langle u_k,x\rangle}{\langle u_k,u_k\rangle}$", fontsize=21, color=BLUE, ha="center", va="center" ) ax.text( 0.862, 0.343, "Divide by the nonzero scalar", fontsize=10, color=SLATE, ha="center", va="center" ) ax.text( 0.862, 0.265, r"$\langle u_k,u_k\rangle=\Vert u_k\Vert^2>0$", fontsize=12, color=INK, ha="center", va="center" )
